summary: Standing R-6 lookout on the Lolo National Forest, Mineral County, Montana; present tower dated 1960 or 1961; staffing today unconfirmed.

facts.design: R-6 cab on a 41-foot treated timber tower
facts.agency: US Forest Service, Lolo National Forest

events.note: Named among new Lolo structures in a 1928 newspaper report quoted by Forest Lookouts
A lookout was employed on Camel's Hump in 1932, per a Mineral Independent item quoted by Forest Lookouts

First lookout, a 20-foot pole tower with L-4 cab, per the Register and firelookout.com
December 1956 Forest Service inspection recommended replacing the tower within two years
Present 41-foot treated timber tower with R-6 cab; the Register gives 1960, firelookout.com gives 1961
Registered April 12, 2022 as US 1546, MT 109; nominated by Kyle Stetler

corrections.why: 6.1 m (20 feet) is the first pole tower; the present tower is a 41-foot tower per the Register and firelookout.com. Editor to confirm whether 41 feet is to the cab floor.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record's note on build years is partly explained: the Register and firelookout.com date the first pole tower to 1935 and the present tower to 1960 or 1961, while the 1956 inspection dates the 50-foot tower then standing to 1933. Whether 1933 and 1935 describe one structure is not settled.

notes_for_editor: Dates disagree and are not settled. Present tower: Register 1960, lookout site 1961. Earlier structure: 1956 inspection gives 'Year Built - 1933' for a 50-foot catwalk tower with a 14 by 14 foot cab; Register and lookout site give 1935 for a 20-foot pole first lookout; a 1928 newspaper lists Camel's Hump among new structures, which would precede 1935. Height correction (record 6.1 m to 12.5 m) assumes the 41-foot figure is to the cab floor; the sources only say '41' tower', so please check. 'Staffed every summer' is in the 2022 Register text and in an older lookout site; no current staffing or access source found. Two web searches returned no rental or visit listing for this lookout (hits were other Camel's Hump peaks). Access left out of facts. No photos added; firelookout.com credits photos but gives no image URLs. Medium confidence because the three historical pages agree on the 1956 replacement need but not on dates.
